best_parts: node film_xA: names the tempting wrong model (haustra as the marker, central loops as colon), refutes it, gives the right marker, and adds a sure_note for confident errors
node num_h9 and coffee_hI: hints name the tempting reason ('9 cm is the big bowel answer'; 'a coiled loop can look like a target') and point to the next thing to check without giving the answer
node inv2 and ladder ladder2_probe pattern: the three-rung ladder is probed as a 4-option item with three different TR5 swaps, so the learner meets the trap in a new form
flaws: node caecum: the key 'Small bowel only' is the shortest option and the only one with the absolute word 'only' (DP1 telegraphing); the same cue recurs in the cold-check segment
node film: the stem already states that the folds cross the full width, so the key is partly given by the stem rather than found by the learner
node sign_xA: tempting line 'a claw sounds like a plain film of bowel gas' is a weak lure, so the option is only a filler for the learner who never met the claw sign

best_parts: node worked_example followed by peer_probe: a one-screen worked read and then a peer error-spotting item, which is a useful second explanation for a learner who missed the first
node films_probe, peer_probe, numbers_probe, sm_probe: a 'Not sure, give me a hint' help option on every probe, so a tired student can ask for help without a wrong tap
node films_t11: sure_note on a confident error, refuting the 'busy film' model with the marker rule
flaws: node peer_probe: option 'Step 3: a 4 cm small bowel is dilated' is a true statement, yet it is labelled a TR12 trap; its feedback node peer_t12 refutes it by talking about 6 cm, which the step never mentions. A learner who has the 3 cm limit is told they are wrong for a correct reading, so this distractor teaches the wrong thing
node why_probe: the key 'Valvulae cross the full width; haustra stop short' is the longest option and the only one that restates the rule, a telegraphing cue (DP1)
node films_probe: only two real choices (small or large bowel) plus help, so the probe is close to a coin toss and cannot separate the two wrong models much

best_parts: node film_a and hint ha_lv / ha_sh: hints name the tempting model and carry a sure_note for confident errors
node ok_c: the key feedback explains why folds that cross the full width are valvulae and why the stop-short film is colon, so a lucky guess still learns the reason
node x_any: names the tempting 'any fold visible' model and refutes it with the reach rule
flaws: node sign1 and ladder: each probe has only two options, one trap and the key, so the learner guesses at 50 percent and the trap is not tested in a second form inside the segment

node film_a2, num2, test_r: the 'retry' re-asks the same question with the same options (Same question, choose again), so the learner who has just been told the answer re-taps it; this is not a delayed re-test
node cmp_a: the stem says 'Film B is the colon', which gives the answer away before the learner chooses

merge_ideas: a's probe structure and sure_note pattern with b's 'Not sure, give me a hint' help option on every probe, so tired learners get a hint without a wrong tap
b's worked_example and peer error-spotting as the second explanation after a missed film probe, with a's tempting-then-refute feedback in place of b's step-3 distractor
give every two-option probe (c's sign1 and ladder) a third trap from the trap map, so each probe offers a real choice and the trap is tested twice
